---

## 1. System Overview & Technology Stack

SpaceCorps 2027 is a real-time multiplayer space combat and trading simulation game client. It is built natively on the Space3d engine, engineered by SpaceCorps.

- **Client Language:** Rust 2024 edition.
- **Rendering Technology:** Native graphics backends via Space3d:
  - macOS: Apple Metal API with native ARM64 Apple Silicon and x86_64 Intel universal binaries.
  - Windows: Direct3D 12 and Vulkan.
  - Linux: Vulkan 1.3 with X11 and Wayland support.
- **Networking:** Secure WebSockets / TLS with continuous state replication to the Sliplane-hosted dedicated server (`https://spacecorps-game.sliplane.app`).
- **Telemetry & Privacy:** Zero surveillance, zero third-party ads, zero tracking cookies. Settings and authentication session tokens are stored locally on the user's filesystem in `~/.spacecorps2027`.

---

## 2. When to Use This Guide

AI agents, automated test suites, and scripting environments should invoke this manual for:

1. **Automating Cross-Platform Deployments:**
   Selecting the exact binary asset URL, extracting files, and handling OS security controls without user intervention.
2. **Deterministic Checksum Validation:**
   Verifying SHA-256 digests against authoritative build artifacts before launching or redistributing packages.
3. **Multi-Region / Custom Server Redirection:**
   Configuring client connection files in `~/.spacecorps2027/` to target private shards or staging deployments on Sliplane.
4. **Automated Diagnostic Health Checks:**
   Querying `https://spacecorps-game.sliplane.app/health` to confirm server readiness.
5. **Localization Resolution:**
   Mapping user language preferences to the 10 available UI and text catalogs.
6. **Game Systems & Lore Intelligence Retrieval:**
   Querying `wiki.json` for ship performance tables, alien counter-strategies, and production chains.

## 3. Package Inventory & Release Artifacts (v0.4.7)

Every release published to `https://github.com/SpaceCorps/play/releases` updates `release.json` with cryptographic digests:

### Asset Matrix

1. **macOS Universal:**
   - Filename: `SpaceCorps2027-macos-universal.dmg`
   - Target Architectures: `aarch64` (Apple Silicon M1/M2/M3/M4) + `x86_64` (Intel)
   - Size: 119,974,414 bytes (120.0 MB)
   - SHA-256: `66c3e7c4add6df0b5e24496ede12f6b83282dfe30e66cf5a756535255b2b963b`
   - URL: `https://github.com/SpaceCorps/play/releases/latest/download/SpaceCorps2027-macos-universal.dmg`

2. **Windows x86_64:**
   - Filename: `SpaceCorps2027-windows-x86_64.zip`
   - Target Architectures: `x86_64` (AMD64 / Intel 64)
   - Size: 114,701,964 bytes (114.7 MB)
   - SHA-256: `d63eda464574fb6cc88cbb303188801c9b324b9cb2f9b5da59fff0ac0deea4dd`
   - URL: `https://github.com/SpaceCorps/play/releases/latest/download/SpaceCorps2027-windows-x86_64.zip`

3. **Linux AppImage:**
   - Filename: `SpaceCorps2027-linux-x86_64.AppImage`
   - Target Architectures: `x86_64`
   - Size: 110,569,976 bytes (110.6 MB)
   - SHA-256: `2390f43a6115689a7f7ab63392a9ae038333cb606c1a6787ba003bb25638e659`
   - URL: `https://github.com/SpaceCorps/play/releases/latest/download/SpaceCorps2027-linux-x86_64.AppImage`

4. **Linux Tarball:**
   - Filename: `SpaceCorps2027-linux-x86_64.tar.gz`
   - Target Architectures: `x86_64`
   - Size: 115,442,520 bytes (115.4 MB)
   - SHA-256: `60d12ecbaa66b74dd3401ddf066813dfeadabfe97867a67200a383c462eed26c`
   - URL: `https://github.com/SpaceCorps/play/releases/latest/download/SpaceCorps2027-linux-x86_64.tar.gz`

Signed checksums: each release also carries `SHA256SUMS` (the SHA-256 of every package above,
`https://github.com/SpaceCorps/play/releases/latest/download/SHA256SUMS`) and `SHA256SUMS.minisig`, its signature by the
SpaceCorps release key ([minisign](https://jedisct1.github.io/minisign/)). The in-game updater installs an
update only when that signature verifies.

## 4. Platform Security & Installation Runbooks

### macOS Security Handling
Because early test releases do not have an Apple Developer ID notarization ticket, Gatekeeper applies quarantine flags to downloads:

1. **GUI Steps (macOS 15 Sequoia+):**
   - Drag `SpaceCorps 2027.app` to `/Applications`.
   - Double-click to launch -> Dialog prompts "SpaceCorps 2027 cannot be opened". Click **Done**.
   - Navigate to **System Settings > Privacy & Security**.
   - Scroll to the Security header where it states `"SpaceCorps 2027 was blocked"`.
   - Click **Open Anyway** and enter your macOS password or Touch ID.

2. **Automated CLI Remediation:**
   ```bash
   xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/SpaceCorps 2027.app"
   ```

### Windows Security Handling
Windows Defender SmartScreen displays a warning on uncataloged executables:

1. Extract the zip: the whole game is in `spacecorps2027.exe` (no `assets` subfolder).
2. Launch `spacecorps2027.exe`.
3. In SmartScreen modal, click **More info** -> **Run anyway**.

### Linux Execution
AppImages require execute permissions and user-space FUSE support:

```bash
chmod +x SpaceCorps2027-linux-x86_64.AppImage
./SpaceCorps2027-linux-x86_64.AppImage
```

If running in a Docker container or environment without `/dev/fuse`:
```bash
./SpaceCorps2027-linux-x86_64.AppImage --appimage-extract-and-run
```
Alternatively:
```bash
tar -xzf SpaceCorps2027-linux-x86_64.tar.gz
cd SpaceCorps2027
./spacecorps2027
```

---

## 5. Network Protocol & Infrastructure

- **Default Server URL:** `https://spacecorps-game.sliplane.app`
- **Health Check:** `GET /health` -> `200 OK`
- **Custom Shard Configuration:**
  Edit the local preferences file:
  - Unix: `~/.spacecorps2027/settings.json`
  - Windows: `%USERPROFILE%\.spacecorps2027\settings.json`
  ```json
  {
    "server": "https://custom-shard.sliplane.app",
    "language": "en"
  }
  ```

## 6. Internationalization Matrix

SpaceCorps 2027 ships with comprehensive translations across 12 languages:

| Code | Language Name | Native Name | Web Address Parameter |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `en` | English | English | `https://spacecorps.github.io/play/?lang=en` |
| `de` | German | Deutsch | `https://spacecorps.github.io/play/?lang=de` |
| `es` | Spanish | Español | `https://spacecorps.github.io/play/?lang=es` |
| `fr` | French | Français | `https://spacecorps.github.io/play/?lang=fr` |
| `it` | Italian | Italiano | not on the download page yet (it shows English) |
| `hu` | Hungarian | Magyar | not on the download page yet (it shows English) |
| `pt-BR` | Portuguese (Brazil) | Português (Brasil) | `https://spacecorps.github.io/play/?lang=pt-BR` |
| `sv` | Swedish | Svenska | `https://spacecorps.github.io/play/?lang=sv` |
| `ru` | Russian | Русский | `https://spacecorps.github.io/play/?lang=ru` |
| `ja` | Japanese | 日本語 | `https://spacecorps.github.io/play/?lang=ja` |
| `ko` | Korean | 한국어 | `https://spacecorps.github.io/play/?lang=ko` |
| `zh-CN` | Chinese (Simplified) | 简体中文 | `https://spacecorps.github.io/play/?lang=zh-CN` |

`?lang=<code>` picks the language of the download page (10 of the 12). In the game: Settings › General ›
Interface Language, or `SPACECORPS_LANG=<code>` for one run.
<!-- /release:languages -->

## 7. Pilot Codex & Game Wiki (Machine Feeds)

The complete SpaceCorps 2027 knowledge base is programmatically synchronized from the base game repository (`assets/wiki`):

- **Interactive Codex Browser:** `https://spacecorps.github.io/play/wiki.html`
- **Structured JSON Catalog:** `https://spacecorps.github.io/play/wiki.json`
- **Raw Markdown Archive:** `https://spacecorps.github.io/play/wiki/`

<!-- release:wiki -->
The catalog contains 39 articles in 5 modules:
1. `01-General`: Getting Started in SpaceCorps, Spacemap Travel.
2. `02-Ships`: Ironclad, Kitefin, Ostirion, Paragon, Protos, Wraith.
3. `03-Mechanics`: Active Ship Abilities, The Black Hole, Cargo Boxes, Clans, Combat Mechanics, Company Pilots, Drone Mechanics, Groups, The Hangar in Flight, Inventory & Equipment, Invite Friends, Quests, Shield Mechanics, Skylab, Speed Calculation, Wipe Timeline & Seasons.
4. `04-Aliens`: Bulwark, Crystalys, Goombah, Phantasm, Seeker.
5. `05-Items`: Boosters, Drones, Extras, The Forge, Lasers & Ammo, Items Overview, Propulsion & Speed, Resources, Rockets, Shields & Defense.
<!-- /release:wiki -->
